title: Regional, religious-order, and mission Eucharistic permissions: bounded cross-tradition review, 2026-10-20
semantics: A dated permission is an authority event scoped to its named people and place; a printing is a book witness; an actual celebration or directly attested operative rule is reception evidence. None alone proves a new rite, substantive textual transition, universal adoption, or ancestry. This receipt records verified bounded findings and leads, not a complete permission census for every diocese, order, mission, or historical century.

review_files.storage: untracked research packets, pinned by SHA-256; claims retained below repeat public source URL and locus

rules_checked.finding: Conference-approved new ritual elements require Apostolic See recognitio; translations require confirmatio. An individual conference vote is not itself the later Roman recognitio, and approval for one territory does not transfer to another.
rules_checked.locus: Postquam Summus Pontifex, 22 October 2021, printed pp. 173-174 nn. 7-12, pp. 179-181 nn. 38-43

rules_checked.finding: A diocesan or religious Proprium Missarum attaches to a Roman Missal; the decree says it is not a separate liturgical book. Count its approved components without multiplying whole-book rites.

permissions.authority: Sviatoslav, Major Archbishop of Kyiv-Halych, following Ukrainian Greek Catholic Church Synod approvals in 2022 and 2023; decree BA 24/027

permissions.date: 2023-10-02 calendar recognition; 2025-07-16 Latin proper recognition; 2025-08-15 order promulgation; 2025-11-30 specified obligation after publication
permissions.scope: Order of Discalced Carmelite Friars; named house-level calendar grades in India, Italy and France, among other local entries
permissions.book_or_component: Latin editio typica altera of the Proprium Missarum OCD, with proper calendar and local Mass formularies; a proper supplement, not a complete stand-alone Roman Missal
permissions.established: The attached Dicastery decree recognizes the Latin second edition of the order's Mass proper. The General Definitory's printed decree promulgates it for the order, permits use once published, and names 30 November 2025 as the date it becomes obligatory. The printed calendar gives memorial rank in houses of India for St Cyriacus Elias Chavara, Italy for St Andrew Corsini, and France for Blessed Mary of the Incarnation Avrillot.
permissions.limit: The printed decree makes use conditional on publication; its date does not prove a 2025 first celebration. The order's 4 September 2025 news item (https://www.carmelitaniscalzi.com/en/2025/09/04/liturgy-of-the-order/) calls 20 November the first Sunday of Advent, conflicting with the signed Latin decree's 30 November; this record follows the decree. The edition's title 'Missale' describes the Mass proper volume, not a whole independent rite, and the cited house examples do not exhaust its local calendar entries.
permissions.locus: Official Latin Proprium Missarum OCD editio typica altera (Rome 2025), printed p. 2 Dicastery recognition of 16 July 2025 (Prot. 726/23), p. 3 order promulgation of 15 August 2025 (Prot. 2025/326 DF), p. 4 India/Italy/France house grades
permissions.actual_use_state: Recognition and conditional order promulgation established; first observed celebration and date of first printed distribution unverified.
